items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: And George and I had a restaurant, a club called the Hitching Post.

ctx.x: Well, anyway, he was a trumpet player. And he had a banjo player named Jack Bastheim, and naturally Gene was on bass. They had a trombone player that had just been over in England working, who had come back to the band. And we played around Dayton for a long time, and a place where we had been working, a Greek.... And George and I had a restaurant, a club called the Hitching Post. So he wanted to cut down on the band, and Gene, he says, "I would like..." He said, "I'll keep you in the band if you want to stay."…
